lessons.claim: Recomputing a derived value from that derivation's own input and comparing **passes identically** -- it is a check that does not run. In trap-drag, φ was recomputed from the lattice (L_x·L_y) and compared, but L_x·L_y is derived from φ, so changing φ to 0.30 still passed. Caught by an adversarial check. A meaningful comparison is against **a value that is written down independently** -- here L2's box_length_x/y (the same attitude as physical.verify recomputing derived_scales).
